---
id: env.def.defence-costs
type: definition
heading: Defence Costs
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Reasonable legal, expert and investigation costs and expenses incurred by us, or by you with our written consent, in investigating, defending, settling or appealing a claim. We will not unreasonably withhold or delay consent. Defence costs do not include your own salaries, overheads or internal costs.
